load_balancing.title: Load balancing
load_balancing.description: Configure the building meter, fuse rating per phase and usable-SoC reserve. The separate Load balancing switch enables Pixii Service 120 soft limits in both directions. Hard limits stay disabled. With no native battery mode, an expiring 15-second Service 129 lease supplies only the live correction and is released as soon as the overload ends. Ending schedules are never restarted or extended. Production control authority and the scheduler Gateway connection are required.

data.recovery_step_w: Increase per polling interval in recovery preview

load_balancing_meter.title: Select building phase measurements
load_balancing_meter.description: Select current (A), voltage (V) and, if available, signed active power (W or kW) for the same phase at the grid connection. Positive power must mean import, negative export. Without per-phase power, currents are shown but power direction cannot be calculated. Do not select inverter currents. Stale or unsynchronized measurements block the calculation.

price_optimization.title: Price optimization
price_optimization.description: Select the electricity-price sensor and planning interval. The optional managed source ID is an explicit boundary for aggregator schedules; schedules from other sources remain protected. Power, usable-SoC, price-difference and export limits are available as device entities. The plan remains a preview until Allow price optimizer to change schedules is enabled.

error.invalid_load_balancing: Check intervals, fuse ratings and power limits.
error.margin_exceeds_fuse: Margin must be below the fuse rating on every used phase.
error.stale_interval_too_short: Maximum measurement age must be at least twice the polling interval.
error.invalid_meter_entities: Select distinct current and voltage sensors for every phase. Each sensor can be selected only once.
error.invalid_price_optimization: Check the price sensor, source ID and planning intervals.
